doshas.touches: the pace at which results arrive
doshas.remedy: A few quiet minutes each Saturday, and feeding birds or a street animal.

doshas.label: Pitra Dosha

doshas.touches: advice, belief and how you weigh counsel
doshas.remedy: Thursday is Jupiter's day: help a teacher or a student, in any small way.

On the Moon, Sun stands for pride and a wish to be seen; the father.
On the Moon, Mercury stands for a worried, busy mind.
On the Moon, Jupiter stands for generosity, good company, faith and children.
Your Lagna, the first flag is pierced by Mars (testing).
Your Moon is pierced by Venus (supportive), and by Saturn (testing).
On the Moon, Venus stands for comfort, art, ease and gain.
On the Moon, Saturn stands for a heavier, more solitary and demanding mood.

sections.heading: A letter from Baba Ji
paragraphs: Dear Aarav. The Sun is your Year Lord, the planet that leads the year, from 1 January until 20 August. This year asks for steady application toward your studies and exam preparation while you live in your family home.

Look forward to the months of July, August, and September. This period brings an open window where your focus produces clear results in your study work. Your daily spiritual practice keeps your mind clear through these active months.
Take each month step by step. Keep your routine plain, review your books with patience, and give yourself time to rest when study feels heavy.

sections.heading: 2027 at a glance
paragraphs: The overall tone of 2027 is a steady, supportive year where you move ahead with care. Your focus remains centered on your studies and exam preparation. July, August, and September are your three strongest months to act and make steady progress.
May is your quietest month, best used for rest and quiet review. Use May to pause, refresh your energy, and steady your mind before the strong months arrive.
The single idea that connects your year is patient dedication to your exam studies while staying grounded in your family home and daily spiritual practice.

sections.heading: Your Year Lord and Muntha
paragraphs: From 1 January until 20 August, your 2026 Varsha chart, which is your solar return chart, is active. The Year Lord, the planet that leads the year, is the Sun during this period. The Muntha, a point that moves one sign each year and shows where attention goes, sits in Gemini in the 3rd house. This placement supports study, clear thinking, and direct effort.

On 20 August, your 2027 solar return chart takes over for the rest of the year. Mars becomes the Year Lord, and the Muntha moves into Cancer in the 1st house. This position brings your personal routine and focus into the spotlight.

A 1st house Muntha can feel demanding because it asks for full personal effort. Maintaining your daily spiritual practice and keeping a predictable study schedule will help you handle this phase with ease.

sections.heading: Your two Varsha charts
paragraphs: Two Varsha charts guide your experience in 2027. The 2026 Varsha chart rules from 1 January until 20 August 2027. During these months, your attention is on quiet effort, learning, and steady preparation for your exam.
On 20 August 2027, the 2027 Varsha chart begins and remains active through 31 December 2027. At this handover, the energy turns toward your personal habits, physical rest, and self discipline.

sections.heading: The big sky moves
paragraphs: Slow moving planets shape the background of your year. Rahu stays in Capricorn in your 6th house, and Ketu stays in Cancer in your 12th house throughout 2027. Saturn starts the year in Pisces in your 8th house, enters Aries in your 9th house on 3 June, turns retrograde on 9 August, and moves back into Pisces on 20 October before turning direct on 24 December.
Jupiter begins in Leo in your 1st house, enters Cancer in your 12th house on 25 January, turns direct on 13 April, enters Leo again on 26 June, and enters Virgo in your 2nd house on 26 November.

Sade Sati is not running for you in 2027. Dhaiya is running in 2027, and it is awake in June, July, August, September, and October while Saturn stays in Aries. During these awake months, focus on rest, maintain your daily study routine, and keep up your daily spiritual practice.

sections.heading: Planet by planet
paragraphs: Sun moves quickly through most of your twelve houses during 2027 and settles in your fifth house by December. It offers steady support for your personal connections, lifting your spirits most in July while requiring extra care in October.

Moon travels across your charts while holding key roles in your solar return calculations. This luminary brings general support to your daily vitality, showing its finest strength in September and its lowest energy in February.

It enters Purva Phalguni on 31 August, bringing recognition in your birth star area, and enters Uttara Phalguni on 4 November, asking you to go gently. Saturn stays in Uttara Bhadrapada, a star of achievement, until 8 February, then moves into Revati, a hard, draining star. On 3 June, Saturn enters Ashwini, a star of support, before moving back into Revati on 20 October.

Ketu remains in Ashlesha as a hard, draining star until 14 August, then enters Pushya, a star of achievement. Rahu stays in Dhanishta, a star of setbacks, until 10 April, then moves into Shravana, a star of wealth and gain. On 18 December, Rahu enters Uttara Ashadha, a star asking you to go gently in your daily work.

Sign changes carry their own Moorti, or planet entry style. Jupiter enters Cancer on 25 January with an iron entry, asking for care, then enters Leo on 26 June with a golden entry for strong focus, and enters Virgo on 26 November with a silver entry. Mars enters Cancer on 9 March with a copper entry, Leo on 26 April with an iron entry, Virgo on 5 July with a golden entry, Libra on 24 August with an iron entry, Scorpio on 8 October with an iron entry, Sagittarius on 18 November with a copper entry, and Capricorn on 27 December with an iron entry. Saturn enters Aries on 3 June with an iron entry, and Pisces on 20 October with a silver entry.

sections.heading: Simple remedies
paragraphs: For your Year Lord, Mars, which holds authority over the second part of your year, set aside a quiet moment every Tuesday. You can spend five minutes in silence or sit with your daily spiritual practice before starting your study routine.

For your Muntha lord, Moon, which rules your annual point of focus, dedicate Mondays to mental stillness. Drinking a glass of clean water calmly every Monday morning helps keep your focus clear for your studies.

For the Saturn influence known as Dhaiya, which tests patience, choose Saturdays for small acts of service. Calling an elder or sharing a bit of food with someone working nearby keeps your mind steady.

sections.heading: What you have been through, and what changes
paragraphs: Between October 2025 and late 2026, your chart carried a heavier stretch. Jupiter moved into your 12th house of quiet reflection on 18 October 2025, stepped back to your 11th house on 4 December 2025, and entered your 12th house again on 1 June 2026. Relief began to form when Jupiter entered your 1st house of personal strength on 30 October 2026, followed by Rahu moving into your 6th house of daily effort on 5 December 2026.

The year 2027 brings its own rhythm with clear turning points. On 25 January 2027, Jupiter steps back from your 1st house into your 12th house for a short period of inner preparation. On 3 June 2027, Dhaiya, a period of careful discipline from Saturn in the 8th house from your Moon, begins and asks for steady focus in your study space.

A major shift of relief arrives on 26 June 2027 when Jupiter moves from your 12th house back into your 1st house. This movement strengthens your confidence and mental clarity. Further balance comes on 20 October 2027 when Dhaiya temporarily ends from your Moon sign.
Keeping your daily spiritual practice while living at home keeps your foundation solid. Your peak months of July, August, and September offer strong backing to advance your preparations.

sections.heading: A closing note from Baba Ji
paragraphs: Aarav, your year opens under the solar return influence with Sun as your initial Year Lord, transitioning to Mars on 20 August 2027. July, August, and September are your peak months where effort brings direct clarity. Focus your energy on your entrance exam preparations during those key stretches.

Living with your parents in the family home gives you a stable background while you prepare. Take quiet steps each month, build a simple daily routine, and rely on your regular practice to guide your study decisions.

sections.heading: Preparing for your entrance exam
paragraphs: Preparing for a management entrance exam while living at home requires steady daily rhythm. Around 26 June 2027, Jupiter moves into Magha in your 1st house, which brings a helpful rise in self discipline and concentration.
Your study momentum and mental clarity gain their best ground between 27 August and 7 October.
Break your syllabus into small weekly goals rather than looking at the whole exam at once. Maintain your daily spiritual practice each morning to keep your mind rested before long study sessions.

sections.heading: Deciding whether to take a gap year
paragraphs: Weighing a gap year for your studies brings questions about timing and long term plans. On 3 June 2027, Saturn moves into Ashwini, encouraging you to look closely at your true academic needs before making quick choices.
The optimal time for making a final decision about your academic path arrives between 27 August and 7 October.
Talk openly with your parents about your preparation timeline while staying grounded in your home routine. Keep your options clear without rushing your choice until your strong window opens.
